name: JM Stringline
crown: Many bodies. One living line. None erased.
core_law: One string. Many bodies. Mesh, not merge.
governing_lines: The estate remembers. The chat thinks.
The Head Chat thinks. The Head Record remembers. Together they govern the string.
Thread the bodies; do not flatten them. Make one line of access, not one mass of sameness.

levels.name: Body
levels.meaning: A sovereign chat, file, app, game, theory, build or other work-body.

levels.name: Stringdoor
levels.meaning: A governed entrance determining what may pass into or out of a body.

levels.name: Thread
levels.meaning: A recognised relationship between two or more bodies.

levels.name: Project String
levels.meaning: The structured continuity joining all relevant project bodies.

levels.name: Project Head Pair
levels.meaning: Head Chat plus Head Record: living thought joined to stable project memory.

levels.name: Estate String
levels.meaning: The governed relationship between separate project strings.

levels.name: JM Estate Head Pair
levels.meaning: Estate Head Chat plus Estate Head Record.

authority_classes.name: Source truth

authority_classes.name: Accepted truth

seed_project_strings.name: Website / Public Estate
seed_project_strings.keeper: The public door must not impersonate the private whole.

seed_project_strings.name: Games&Beyond
seed_project_strings.keeper: One front door. Many sovereign game rooms.

seed_project_strings.name: Theory Estate
seed_project_strings.keeper: Preserve the occurrence. Separate the claims. Trace every route.

seed_project_strings.name: Coding / OS Estate
seed_project_strings.keeper: Use my actual coding bodies every single time.

seed_project_strings.name: Lyrics & Music
seed_project_strings.keeper: I know what I know. Let’s get on with the show.

boundary: This seed defines and powers a local-first Stringline interface. It does not claim cross-chat platform embedding, a custom rendering engine, universal parser completion, or autonomous access to every estate body.
